## Activity

During December 2023, Central Eye Clinic completed 170 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. The reported capture total should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the grading outcomes recorded below.

## Image quality

A total of 3 captures were ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 1.8. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality during routine activity and record recurring camera issues with the service desk. Logging these issues supports follow-up and helps maintain consistent capture quality.

## Grading

There were 50 referable results during December 2023. The median grading lag was 3. This measure should be reviewed with the monthly activity and image-quality findings to support ongoing operational oversight. Continued attention to camera performance, capture quality and grading workflow will help the clinic identify issues promptly and maintain reliable reporting.
